phase: 1 — VulnGAT-HR head refit (frozen encoder, MSE-only, val-Spearman selection)

protocol.selection: val Spearman on non-zero val nodes (161)
protocol.head: Sequential(Linear(128,1), Sigmoid) — mirrors original classifier
protocol.batch_size_rationale: orders pin lr/epochs/seed but not batch size; full-batch (=1 Adam step/epoch) under-converged (best epoch = the 500 cap, test Spear_all 0.47-0.56); bs selected among {32,64,128,256} purely on the ordered val selection metric (val Spearman-nz); all four converge to the same zone (test RankAcc-all 85.4-85.9%)

sanity_gate.interpretation: The 85-88% anchors (ridge 88.5%, fresh linear head 87.1%) are ALL-cut numbers. Measured ceiling for any linear head on the nz cut = ridge at 72.03% (this head: 69.98% = 97.2% of the closed-form ceiling). On the comparable all cut this head lands 85.55% vs the 85-88% anchor zone. Wiring verified: ridge on the cached embeddings reproduces the 0.7775/88.54% anchor exactly (cache, masks, labels correct); convergence verified by batch-size sweep.
